chunks: Has there come to you the story of the hordes?
ai.seo_question: What is the story of the hordes mentioned in Surah Al-Buruj?
ai.summary: This verse opens Surah Al-Buruj by invoking the story of the People of the Ditch (Ahl al-Kahf), where King Al-Najashi persecuted early Muslims for their faith. In Shia exegesis, this narrative underscores the theme of divine retribution against tyrants and the steadfastness of the believers, serving as a precursor to the surah's emphasis on the Hereafter and God's absolute power.
